memory.note: Verified 2026-09-05 on this machine: `grok --help` lists `--always-approve`, `-m/--model` and `--cwd <CWD>`, and describes `-c` as continuing 'the most recent session for the current working directory'. There is NO --add-dir or equivalent, so an agent given its own cwd cannot be granted the repo — the launcher warns. ~/.grok/sessions holds one directory per percent-encoded absolute cwd, so the key is the cwd.

bootstrap_message: Read {{bootstrap_file}} and follow it exactly. Reply with the single word READY once you have read it and every skill it lists.
install_hint: Install Grok Build from xAI and run `grok login`.
notes: No system-prompt flag and no extra-directory flag: a grok agent must run with the repo as its cwd, which means it shares memory with any other grok agent in the same repo. Add a ready.pattern once the prompt glyph is known.
